539-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
539-4687-4929.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1636-4147-4215-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4147-4215-8095.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3593-4247-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
3593-4247-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

1981-2415-3899-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-5468.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6141.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Displacer Beast from exile to the battlefield.
When Displacer Beast enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Beast trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-4785-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4785-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1368-6006-6321-6968.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6006-6321-6968.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3617-4477-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-5088-5148-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
3967-5088-5148-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
3967-5088-5148-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

1809-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and exiling Ephemerate.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2034-7216.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

539-5411-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-2459-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-5147-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-5147-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

640-2173-5010-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

280-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
280-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1429-5315-6792.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

4017-5641-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5641-6719.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3330-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3330-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

944-1020-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

790-2152-4651.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-2152-4651.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

1545-2034-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1545-2034-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Trostani indestructible.
1545-2034-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1659-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

144-413-628.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Ashcloud Phoenix trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 6, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

413-803-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
413-803-5853.notablePrerequisites:
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
You control no more than one Snail.
413-803-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Snail, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick and Blasting Station trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

2933-4013-5223-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4753--39.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4753--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Clever Impersonator trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
